authorization: The user explicitly authorized execution after reviewing the frozen M2 vector-modulation proposal.
question: Holding M2 inputs, persistent state, readout, task streams, optimization, observation process, and evaluation arrays fixed, does replacing the shared scalar write modulator with a postsynaptic-neuron-specific instantaneous vector recover constrained Liu morphology without damaging competence?
claim_boundary: The candidate differs from M2 only in the instantaneous modulation head and write equation: m=W_m*h+b_m is length 200 and P'=clip(P+m[:,None]*E,-50,50). Rows index postsynaptic neurons.
P remains the only episode-persistent plastic state. Hidden state h and eligibility E remain trial-local transient states, and every query reads the same terminal P without writeback.
This is an exposed development study using the prospectively fixed first three numeric parent seeds 3041 through 3043. It cannot provide confirmation or immediate main-model promotion.

Shared initial tensors and all 1500 generic training batches must be bit-identical to paired frozen M2. The new vector head is initialized exactly to zero; no evaluation or human information enters training.

No alpha, L, normalized time, duplicate q, value head, blank training rollout, terminal-P penalty, noise training, auxiliary loss, curriculum, restart, checkpoint selection, or vector-specific optimizer setting is added.
The vector-use residual is a descriptive computation diagnostic. It does not establish causal benefit, reliability coding, confidence, or a biological implementation.
The fixed recipe stops after three seeds. Only the registered candidate_rescue outcome authorizes a separately frozen fresh twenty-seed confirmation; no outcome authorizes tuning this cohort.

design.sampling_unit: Network is the development sampling unit; panels remain nested and participants are never pooled across networks.
design.exposure_barrier: Train and jointly lock all three final models before generic evaluation; freeze and commit all nine generic units before any Liu evaluation; evaluate all 27 Liu units without selection.

model.name: M2-vector-modulation
model.vector_orientation: m_i gates row i of P and therefore the incoming plastic synapses of postsynaptic neuron i.
model.dynamic_state: P is the only episode-persistent plastic state; h and E reset per trial and P resets per episode; queries do not write back.
model.modulation_initialization: All vector-head weights and biases are exactly zero after canonical parent initialization.

training.task: Exact frozen M2 clean generic task and realized-q streams.
training.optimizer: One Adam group for all trainable tensors; betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0, amsgrad=false; no scheduler or gradient clipping.
training.loss: Mean softplus(-y*M) over all 28 generic queries.
training.selection: Final checkpoint only; no early stopping, intermediate selection, restarts, continuation, or result-conditioned change.
training.diagnostic_boundary: Training diagnostics are integrity checks only and cannot select, stop, repair, or tune a run.

generic_evaluation.inputs: Exact three frozen M2 generic panels.
generic_evaluation.panel_gate: All competence lower95>0.5, both P-dependence lower95>0, and coherence lower95>0.95.
generic_evaluation.paired_preservation: For rescued networks, candidate-minus-M2 mean learned and nonlearned competence must each be at least -0.02 in every generic panel. This descriptive development bound supplements, but does not replace, the absolute panel gate.

liu_evaluation.inputs: Exact frozen clean, folded, and noisy arrays from the M2 observation study; sigma remains 1/7 where applicable.
liu_evaluation.behavior: Reuse all nine qualitative rows, evidence binding, continuous summaries, and the complete subject-level behavior.
liu_evaluation.constrained_unit: A noisy unit is constrained only when its network is stable_constructive, evidence binding passes, all nine qualitative rows pass, latent_bimodal_pairs>=15, sampled_bimodal_pairs>=15, and no ordinary-unimodal or low-accuracy pair is introduced by the unchanged classifier.
liu_evaluation.damage_guard: A rescued network fails preservation if any noisy panel introduces a low-accuracy or ordinary-unimodal pair, or if learned, nonlearned, or overall mean exact correctness is more than 0.02 below paired M2.

write_geometry.proposal: U=m[:,:,None]*E before clipping, measured only during support microsteps.
write_geometry.inactive: If ||E||_F or ||U||_F is at or below 1e-12, mark the subject-step inactive and do not zero-fill R.
write_geometry.use_rule: vector_used is true for a network when at least one evaluated support subject-step is active and its maximum R exceeds 1e-10. R magnitude is descriptive and is not a behavioral success threshold.

outcomes.generic_inadequate: Fewer than two of three networks are stable_constructive.
outcomes.mixed_or_damaging: At least two networks are stable_constructive, but any otherwise rescued network fails a registered generic or Liu preservation guard.
outcomes.candidate_rescue: At least two networks are stable_constructive, vector_used, pass all preservation guards, and each has at least one constrained noisy panel.
outcomes.used_without_rescue: At least one network is vector_used but candidate_rescue does not apply and no preceding outcome applies.
outcomes.vector_not_used: No network is vector_used and no preceding outcome applies.

decision.confirmation: Only candidate_rescue authorizes a separately frozen, unchanged, fresh twenty-seed paired confirmation.
decision.mechanism_control: Only a confirmed rescue may authorize separately frozen scalar projection and amplitude-matched controls; c*E and c_amp*E are distinct controls.
decision.promotion: Main-model promotion is always false in this development study.

qualification.pairing: Shared initial tensor hashes must equal M2 for all three seeds. Replicating the scalar parent head across rows must recover the parent forward computation exactly, without claiming optimizer equivalence.
qualification.equations: An independent eager reference must match margin, vector modulation, h, E, P, loss, gradients, and one Adam update; verify row orientation, P-before-E, clipping, resets, query no-write, and exact parameter count.
qualification.symmetry_break: On a fixed multi-support synthetic batch, zero-initialized vector-head rows must receive finite, nonzero, non-identical gradients.
qualification.runtime: Actual-shape eager/compiled CUDA forward, gradients, and one Adam step must agree at atol=1e-5 and rtol=1e-4.
qualification.evaluation: Synthetic fixtures cover vector-use inactivity, scalar-subspace R=0, heterogeneous R>0, generic categories, evidence binding, morphology gates, preservation guards, and all outcome labels before execution.
qualification.failure: Any failed qualification blocks training. Repairs are append-only and cannot alter candidate, seeds, streams, objective, inputs, thresholds, or exposure order.

execution.runtime: CUDA float32 without autocast or TF32; compiled fullgraph/default training and evaluation; one Torch/BLAS/compiler thread; float64 summaries.
freeze_points: Commit the protocol before candidate implementation or outcome exposure.
Commit qualified implementation plus source/input/replay lock before seed 3041 training.
Train all three models and commit one joint model lock before generic evaluation.
Evaluate all nine generic units and commit their canonical result before Liu evaluation.
Evaluate all 27 Liu units, freeze one canonical result and concise report, commit, and stop.
execution.retention: Keep protocol, qualification, locks, canonical results, reports, compact diagnostic tables, and three final checkpoints until a separately authorized retention migration; reference parent artifacts without duplication.
